h1: Navarat Heritage Hotel — a central hotel on the Ping within steps of the Walking Street and street food
intro: If you want a central base in Kamphaeng Phet where you can walk to everything, Navarat Heritage Hotel is the name most visitors think of first. It's a 71-room 3-star hotel set on the Ping River, right beside the town's Walking Street and night market. It's been around a while but was renovated in 2020, so the rooms are roomier and cleaner than you'd expect. There's an on-site cafe, a fitness room, free bikes to borrow, free parking, and a riverside to stroll in the evening. Rooms start from about ฿1,000/night — a sensible pick for travellers who value location and value-for-money over luxury.

body.html: What makes Navarat Heritage popular in Kamphaeng Phet is its central location, within walking distance of almost everything. The hotel sits on the Ping River and right beside the Walking Street and night market — in the evening you step out of the lobby and you're among the food stalls and market buzz in a few paces. It's close to the health park, the hospital and the town's restaurants. Many guests say getting this kind of location at this price is genuinely good value, ideal for travellers who want to explore the town without driving anywhere far.

Although it's a long-established hotel, the 2020 renovation makes the rooms feel fresher and cleaner than you might assume. Standard rooms like the Deluxe King, Superior Twin and Deluxe Twin are fairly spacious, with comfy beds, air-con, a TV, a fridge/minibar and a hot shower; some face the Ping River. Guests repeatedly mention the rooms are large and well-maintained for an older building. The reception staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful, which makes the overall stay feel easy and reassuring.
"Big, clean, nicely renovated rooms at a fair price — you can walk straight out to the walking street and the food. The staff were lovely and very helpful. Overall good value for this town."

For food, there's the on-site Garnet cafe serving Thai and international dishes, plus a buffet breakfast (chargeable, served in the morning). On top of that there's a fitness room, free bicycles to borrow for a spin around town, free parking and free Wi-Fi throughout. For a hotel in this class the facilities are well covered, even though there's no swimming pool to dip into.

To be straight about it: this is a renovated older building, not a brand-new property. A few reviews mention a musty smell in some rooms and an older-era feel to parts of the building, so if you're expecting something brand new or contemporary in design it may not match. And because it's right by the Walking Street, there can be some outside noise on market nights. These are worth knowing so you can pick the right room and timing for you.

For sightseeing, the location is well connected. Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) is about 3 km away — a few minutes by car or bike — with Wat Phra Kaeo and the cluster of ancient monuments on that side too. The Ping River right in front of the hotel is lovely for an evening stroll in the breeze. Overall scores are solid — Trip.com around 8.5 and Booking around 7.8 from dozens of reviews — reflecting how much guests value the location and price.

In short, Navarat Heritage Hotel suits travellers who want a central, good-value base in Kamphaeng Phet, walkable to the Walking Street and the river rather than luxury or new design. You get spacious renovated rooms, decent facilities and an easy onward trip. If you can accept a renovated older building and want a base you can step out of and explore the town on foot, this is one of the most sensible choices in town.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Navarat Heritage Hotel, Kamphaeng Phet

faq.q: Where is Navarat Heritage Hotel in Kamphaeng Phet?
faq.a: It's in central Kamphaeng Phet, on the Ping River and right beside the Walking Street / night market. Step out of the hotel and you're among the street food and riverside in a few paces. Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) and Wat Phra Kaeo are about 3 km away, a few minutes by car or bike.

faq.q: How much does Navarat Heritage Hotel cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: A Superior Twin starts from about ฿1,000/night; a Deluxe King is around ฿1,150; a Deluxe Twin around ฿1,250; and a Family Room for groups around ฿1,600. Prices vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is the hotel old, and what are the rooms like?
faq.a: It's a hotel that opened in 2000 but was renovated in 2020, so the rooms are roomier and cleaner than you might expect, with air-con, TV, minibar and a hot shower; some face the Ping River. Worth knowing: it's a renovated older building, parts still feel dated, and some rooms have a musty smell — ask for a refreshed room.

faq.q: What food and facilities does Navarat Heritage Hotel have?
faq.a: There's an on-site Garnet cafe serving Thai and international dishes and a buffet breakfast (charged extra). It also has a fitness room, free bicycles to borrow, free parking and free Wi-Fi throughout. However, there's no swimming pool.

faq.q: Who is Navarat Heritage Hotel best for, and how does it score?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a central, good-value base in Kamphaeng Phet, walkable to the Walking Street and the river — a handy base for exploring the town and the Historical Park. Scores are solid — Trip.com around 8.5 and Booking around 7.8 from dozens of reviews. Just note it's a renovated older building with no pool and possible noise from the Walking Street on market nights.
